name: Icecrine
description: A nostalgic Japanese-style soft ice cream known as 'icecrine' — lighter and less sweet than western ice cream, with a clean milky flavor. A beloved treat across all ages.

name: Today's Ice Cream
description: A seasonal ice cream selection that changes daily. Ask our staff for today's flavor — it reflects the best of what's in season.

name: Cheesecake
description: A rich, creamy cheesecake made with premium ingredients. Dense yet light, with a satisfying tartness. Pairs beautifully with our house-roasted coffee.

name: Cheesecake & Coffee Set
description: Our house cheesecake paired with a cup of our house-roasted coffee. A relaxing way to end your meal — available at a discounted price when added to a meal order.
